Verſ. 13.
This is the word that the Lord hath ſpoken againſt Moab ſince that time.

THis ſhort ſentence is the confirmation of the propheſie: for his meaning is, that he hath euen pronounced the very decree of God himſelfe, and hath vttered nothing but the Lords meſſage. Thus putting off as it were the perſon of man, he brings in God ſpeaking in this manner:
